scope: Frozen isolated P11 software-core draft and integration contract; not selected production FW
states: OFF/WIT optional: original parser branch remains selectable
WAIT_ZERO: trusted fresh R0 IDLE + measured still500ms + drained/quiet source + new session authorized, zero only
ARMED: subsequent distinct timestamped complete CRC/range frame can propose velocity
LOCKED: R0 loss, P11 arrival age>=200ms, feedback age>=50ms or raw integrity fault; numeric zero and latched until another trusted new-session request plus fresh zero

raw_UART_contract.physical_input: A15 existing imu_rxd -> u_imu byte/FIRST FIFO
raw_UART_contract.selected_sender: 50Hz10-byte frames in separate bursts; >=500us idle between packets. Sender starts only after fresh management ACK and sends new zero first.
raw_UART_contract.arrival_stamp: Actual FIRST start time; conservative packet-start age, never software dequeue time
raw_UART_contract.guard: Before and after each data/FIRST timestamp pair, verify monotone overflow baseline, count<=32 and elapsed<100us. Missing/zero stamp, misordering or backlog faults quarantine; all selected-mode old/WIT consumers disabled.
raw_UART_contract.reason: At most32 queued byte/FIRST records, plus at most2 pipeline entries, fit34 timestamp slots; a FIRST requires>=500us idle. Measured100us pair bound avoids an unchecked producer interval. This inference still needs actual-MMIO ordering and worst-case service validation.
raw_UART_contract.drain: In quarantine do not accept packets. Bounded drain of up to258 data and34 timestamp records, then require >=2ms with no new bytes; explicitly new trusted management request. A flood never becomes armed. Do not reset CPU/control/RAW RAM to fake an empty stream.
raw_UART_contract.unresolved: Current HAL has no explicit timestamp-valid status and reads DATA before TS. The proposed bounds/zero rejection and quiet flush require a real MMIO miter; this draft core API alone does not establish FIFO pairing.

Expose existing raw divisor/idle/count/overflow/TS reads. Add measured DATA/FIRST+TS pair helper and bounded quiet flush; maintain existing final host_link_guard_filter and SAFE commit ordering. Do not override a checked zero with a nonzero UART target in HAL.

Keep the original10Hz planning publication and hardware125Hz policy; received50Hz targets are staged. IDLE/ESTOP/guard lock force zero. Return to NAV clears manual state and never resumes an old autonomous task.
